title: A Primer of the Rope Dart
summary: Teaches an untrained beginner the first throws and guards of the rope dart using body strength alone.

title: Drill-Book of the Cord and Weight
summary: Drills the whirl and swing of the weighted cord until the student can keep it moving without tangling.

title: Handbook of Dart Swings
summary: Explains the steady pendulum swing of the dart and the few strikes that grow out of it.

title: The Plain Cord-Dart Workbook
summary: Sets out graded exercises for wrist and forearm so a tendon-trained student can handle cord and dart together.

title: Treatise on Reeling the Dart Home
summary: Shows how to haul a thrown dart back at once so it can strike again before the foe closes.

title: Short Canon of the Tethered Point
summary: Teaches a newly awakened student to run a thread of qi along the cord to steady the dart.

title: A Beginner's Book of Cord Wraps
summary: Introduces the wraps and loops that let a qi-awake beginner catch a limb or a weapon shaft.

title: Common Method for the Weighted Cord
summary: Covers the full round of throws and recoveries for the weighted cord with a light pulse of qi.

title: Handbook of Qi on the Cord
summary: Shows how a thin stream of qi can stiffen or soften the cord at the student's will.

title: Primer of the Long-Tail Dart
summary: Teaches the longer cord and its wider reach to students who already circulate qi.
